thread:
maria.finance: Hey @channel — vendor reply on MLCostBench trial just came in. They offered 3 months free + $0 setup. Question: does 'free' include embeddings/ingest egress costs? They mention 'usage cap 50k tokens/day' but also 'overages billed monthly'. Link: https://mlcostbench.example/pricing  /cc @samir.procure
samir.procure: Thanks. Do we have expected token volumes for test workloads? I think initial ingest will be ~20M tokens for eval set, plus ~100k tokens/day after. If overage calc is per-token, need unit price. Ask for price per 1M tokens + per-GB embedding storage.
jess-platform: FYI they also support dedicated instances; pricing sheet had a 'dedicated tier' line. Might be cheaper if we do a 6mo pilot. See snippet they sent:
```
Trial: 3mo free
Overages: $0.50 per 1k tokens (generation)
Embeddings storage: $12 per GB-month
Dedicated pilot: $6k/month (up to 4 GPUs)
```
maria.finance: That overage $0.50 per 1k tokens seems high vs our current cost. Can vendor justify? Also need invoicing terms (net30 vs net45) and PO process. @vendor-rep-amy can you confirm if VAT applies and whether net30 is available for startups?
vendor-rep-amy: Hi Maria — thanks for the questions. VAT depends on billing address; net30 is standard for pilot contracts but we can do net45 for education/nonprofit. Overages are for burst traffic; long-run customers move to reserved pricing. I can ask sales to provide a per-1M token tiered schedule. I'll also confirm embeddings storage discounts.
samir.procure: Great — ask for tiered pricing and one-line SOW for a 3mo pilot + opt-in to dedicated. Also push for SLA credit clause and data deletion at end. Can we get a sample invoice PDF? Need to validate accounting fields (billing contact, tax id, bank wires).
vendor-rep-amy: Attaching sample invoice — https://mlcostbench.example/sample-invoice.pdf. Will include bank details and tax fields. Also attached revised pricing to show tiered overage bands.
maria.finance: Perfect. If they can drop overage to <$100 per 1M tokens and allow net30 with PO, we can approve pilot. I'll prepare a short approval request for finance ops.
jess-platform: One more ask — confirm whether ingest analytics count towards tokens (they often count) or only generated tokens.
vendor-rep-amy: Good question — ingest + generation both count against token usage. We can provide a CSV daily usage export or set up read-only dashboard access.
maria.finance: Thanks — sounds doable. I'll wait for the tiered schedule and invoice with accounting details before sending approval. :thumbsup:
